versions.text: Each position light intensity must equal or exceed the applicable values in the following table: Dihedral angle (light included) Angle from right or left of longitudinal axis, measured from dead ahead Intensity (candles) L and R (forward red and green). 0° to 10° ------------------------------- 40 10° to 20° ----------------------------- 30 20° to 110° -------------------------- 5 A (rear white) ------------------------ 110° to 180° ------------------------- 20
